verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents assigning roles to members, including preset and custom roles that override base roles [docs-36, docs-66]. It also documents API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict which operations they perform, such as read-only integrations [docs-37, docs-67]. Approval workflows add a further change-control layer [docs-52]. missing for 10: explicit evidence of resource-level scoping that restricts changes to specific flags, projects or environments (the 'which flags' part), detail on the custom-role policy model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
